content: If the cost of installing the required electric vehicle charge point and cable routes for electric vehicle charge points exceeds 7% of the total cost of the major renovation (a) such a building is exempt from the requirement to install the electric vehicle charge point; and (b) cable routes for electric vehicle charge points must be installed in a minimum of one fifth of the total number of parking spaces, except where the cost of that installation exceeds 7% of the total cost of the major renovation.
question: What percentage of the total cost of the major renovation must the cost of installing the required electric vehicle charge point and cable routes exceed for a building to be exempt from the requirement to install the electric vehicle charge point?
